title: Vedant Poly Fabs IPO Details
intro:
Vedant Poly Fabs IPO is a book build issue of ₹56.68 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 54.26 lakh shares aggregating to ₹51.01 crores and offer for sale of 6.04 lakh shares aggregating to ₹5.67 crores.

Vedant Poly Fabs IPO opens for subscription on Nov 2, 2026 and closes on Nov 4, 2026. The allotment for the Vedant Poly Fabs IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 5, 2026. Vedant Poly Fabs IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 9, 2026.

Vedant Poly Fabs IPO is set issue price band at ₹88 to ₹94 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,25,600 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,38,400.

Affinity Global Capital Market Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Cameo Corporate Services Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Vedant Poly Fabs IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

The company operates as a B2B supplier and offers a diverse range of packaging products, including 3-layer and 5-layer LD films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches, catering to industries such as food & beverages and other consumer goods.

Since commencing operations, the company has expanded its product portfolio, strengthened its manufacturing capabilities, and established dedicated teams across sales, design, production, logistics, and dispatch. In March 2026, it further enhanced its manufacturing capacity by adding lamination, slitting, and pouching machines, while also installing a reprocessing unit to improve resource utilization and recycle manufacturing waste.

The company follows an integrated manufacturing process covering raw material procurement, film extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting, quality control, packing, and dispatch. As of March 31, 2026, Vedant Poly Fabs had a workforce of 72 employees, including 41 permanent and 31 contractual employees, supporting its manufacturing and business operations.

Vedant Poly Fabs Limited was incorporated in December 2018 and is engaged in the manufacturing of flexible packaging materials for businesses across India. The company operates as a B2B supplier and offers a diverse range of packaging products, including 3-layer and 5-layer LD films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches, catering to industries such as food & beverages and other consumer goods.

Since commencing operations, the company has expanded its product portfolio, strengthened its manufacturing capabilities, and established dedicated teams across sales, design, production, logistics, and dispatch. In March 2026, it further enhanced its manufacturing capacity by adding lamination, slitting, and pouching machines, while also installing a reprocessing unit to improve resource utilization and recycle manufacturing waste.

The company follows an integrated manufacturing process covering raw material procurement, film extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting, quality control, packing, and dispatch. As of March 31, 2026, Vedant Poly Fabs had a workforce of 72 employees, including 41 permanent and 31 contractual employees, supporting its manufacturing and business operations.

Vedant Poly Fabs Ltd.'s revenue increased by 41% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 140% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vedant Poly Fabs IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Vedant Poly Fabs IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Vedant Poly Fabs IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Vedant Poly Fabs IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: Vedant Poly Fabs IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,25,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Vedant Poly Fabs IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Vedant Poly Fabs IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Vedant Poly Fabs IPO will be done on Thursday, November 5, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Nov 6, 2026 . Check the Vedant Poly Fabs IPO allotment status .
